2 قبّب He (a man) made a قُبَّة [q. v.]: (K:) or so ↓ قَبَّ : (TA:) and قبّب قُبَّةً, (M, TA,) inf. n. تَقْبِيبٌ, (TA,) he made, (M,) or constructed, (TA,) a قَبَّة. (M, TA.) [Hence,] الهَوَادِجُ تُقَبَّبُ [The women's camel vehicles of the kind called هوادج have dome-like, or tent-like, coverings made to them]. (S, O.) ―
-b2- [Hence also,] قبّب ظَهْرَهُ [He (a man) made his back round like a dome, lowering his head]. (S and K in art. دبخ.) ＝
-A2- See also 1, in two places, near the middle and near the end.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
